Question: How was your day?
Answer: This is about August 14, 2024. From this day, I don't think YouTube or Quora can fulfill my dopamine needs. Make sure to read till the end, this is really good or atleast better than nibba nibbi posts you read on Quora. Before starting, see this dog, this dog put us in many problems which I'll discuss as we continue ahead and the things will get crazier as we proceed. (The picture is epic fr and so this dog) Let's start from the very beginning. I had only one class that too of an humanities elective, like it is okay to skip that. I'm dividing this post into 5 segments naming them S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5. Things will get more interesting with time. And I will write only till S4. S1 : Beginning S2 : Basic Trek + Lost in the Jungle + Scaring a couple + Haters OP S3 : No more solo trip + Tale of 1 Dog & 4 Langoor S4 : One Tree Hill Climbing + One Tree Hill Trek (“let us know if you reach the bottom”) S5? Some other day! If you want to read only crazy things, go and start reading from S3. And make sure to read S4 no matter who you are. S1 and S2 are like first half of the movie. (S1) I slept at 2 AM, set up 10 alarms, each of them with a gap of 5 minutes as I don't trust myself with waking up. Lol, sometimes I literally turn down volume to 0, to prevent this, I downloaded an app that make volume buttons useless. Anyways, I woke up at 4 AM by first alarm only. I decided to go for a solo trek. Last time, I explored 25% of the hill station named Matheran so I decided to see the rest today and I didn't had even 1% clue of what is going to happen today. I was ready to leave for the Kanjurmarg station by 4:40 and I don't know why I booked Uber to the station and it got accepted in no time. Reaching station takes around 15 min. in the morning but the train I was planning to board comes at Kanjurmarg at 5:26 AM (the train that ends at Karjat). That means, I'm fucking half hour early. I reach the station by 4:55 AM almost, I paid the guy with GPay but as I scanned, he started walking towards the station, I had no clue of where he was going without confirming my payment. I followed him, he was going to tea shop. I reached the tea shop, show him the payment and he was like “Okay Okay, thik hai.”. There was one guy who said something about me like it was positive only but I don't remember. Anyways, I reached the station around 25 min. and waited there for my train early? Yes? Hell No. As I stepped the platform, a train arrives that has stops at Thane. I had almost 0 cash like not 0 but close to it as I use UPI mostly. So I thought I will look for ATM in Thane and will board my train from there. For Mumbaikers only, Also, I thought since Thane is one of the most important station, I should take train to Neral from there. I don't know but I had some gut feeling that this is going to be good. Miracle! I arrived at Thane around 5:12 AM and guess what! A train to Khopoli was waiting to leave Thane at 5:17 AM. (Khopoli is like end station, all in all, my decision to come early turned out to be a good one) Baaki fir, I reached Neral station (station nearest to Hill Station of Matheran) around 6:40 AM. Yes, I expected to reach by 8 AM. Then, there was one Hitachi ATM (Yes, that same ATM which didn't work last time I visited and guess what, this time it worked) I debit some cash from there and I was all set to reach the hill station and start exploring. Really? No! I was visiting on Wednesday. So, it was difficult to get a cab to the hill station. Cab carries 5 people but I was alone. And no way I will pay him 5X of the fare. No one arrived in next 5 min. I started talking to cab driver about his life and everything. In my mind, I was like “BC Wednesday ko kyu aa gaya”. Anyways, 5 min. later a couple arrived. 5 more minutes later, a family of 3 arrived, one of them was child. So they adjusted everything. And by around 7:30 AM, I reached Matheran. (S2) Last time, I took e-rickshaw to reach the market. This time, I used my legs and walked to the main market. It was 2.2 KM. I primarily took the decision to have some scenic view that most of the people miss. I was walking alone, like no one was there I mean no tourist was there. Some locals were roaming I mean those work there. I decided to play some music with loud volume and it was good. Then, the first point arrived. It was Myra Point. This was the view.. Like the view is Okay. I know the photo is not good. I had a packet of Britannia Cake, I was hungry and it did the job. But more was yet to come. What's the craziest thing you can imagine seeing this view? Yes. I did the same which will come ahead. Anyways, I talked to parents and brother, listen some songs, clicked some photos there. I was completely alone there. Neh, I wasn't alone, there were 4 dogs with me but sad, i didn't bring any food with me this time. So I couldn't feed anything. It was about 8:40 AM, I started my journey from Myra point. I took rest for half hr. (Very random scene) Instead of going to the market, I decided to go somewhere else and see some view, I started sweating so much that my handkerchief got wet. I brought a cute red colored mini-towel with me, I started using it. I was walking and suddenly I observed that one water pipe was leaking like it was not leaking completely, just 1–2% of water was leaking out of it. Anyways, I ignored it. There were two ways, left and right. I took right and then I saw that there was a very random park. I entered it, it was good like okayish. I didn't click any photo. I left the park and took right again, it was something like Ganga Sagar, like a colony type area arrived idk, i took right from there too. All I was doing was following boards in my way and I wanted to go to Monkey Point. I left Myra Point at 8:40 AM. It was around 10 AM. I was walking and suddenly I observed that one water pipe was leaking like it was not leaking completely, just 1–2% of water was leaking out of it. Seems repetitive thing, right? Yes, I was lost in the Jungle. I arrived at the same fkin place. I wasted 30 min. doing nothing. I saw a couple some 200 M from me. I was getting bored and feeling sad as things weren't getting interesting. I decided to make it interesting. I suddenly started running towards them and said ki, “Aage Leopard Hai Bhaago”. They got scared and started running too, like I can't tell how happy I was at this moment. Remembering their reaction, I can't stop laughing😂 obviously I didn't record them, one of the biggest mistake of my life. Imagine two people walking romantically and then this happens. Anyways, I started walking and reached Echo Point some time later… A couple was doing something, so I didn't get a chance to click better image. I saw 2–3 views too. Untill I realised I'm hungry. Near to me, there was a place called Charlotte Lake which is usually very crowded. I walked to that place. I reached there by around 10:50 AM. This was the view… Anyways, I was so tired so tired that I thought of waiting there for 1 hr. infront of a mini dam which look like this… This was the view of the dam.. I got my network there and I was happy now. I went to get some cold drink. It was priced at ₹45 but the lady shopkeeper asked me ₹60. Expensive? Yes. But seeing the height and the way to that shop, It was Ok. I gave her a ₹100 note, she didn't had change and she gave me ₹50. Now, I don't know if I saved ₹10 or I overpaid ₹5? Then, I created two posts on Quora, first on a Nashedi and second on one follower of Nashedi who says that's I'm bad but she DM me to know my future. Anyways, let's not give them much space on my profile. I deleted two of my posts as I realised that I wrote them out of boredom and those posts don't deserve to be on my profile and also, Quora restricted one of them. I deleted both of them by 12:10 PM ig. I saw 2–3 views but didn't click any good photo of them as my phone was in battery saver mode. Then, I used Mappls, it was working even with very minimal network. I went to market and on the way, my mobile got dead. My water finished, my cold drink too got over. I was alone again. I was sweating a lot. I removed my shirt. I was wearing blue shirt over a white tshirt. It was ok at this point. I went to an outlet, asked him to charge my mobile. I ate Sandwich there. It was expensive honestly. My phone charged to 50%. My tummy full. My water bottle full. No more sweat on the body. I left the market around 1 PM. (S3) It is around 1:30 PM, now I had Mappls matlab I can't lost in my way. I reached Alexandra Point. This made my day. Fast winds + this view but here, I was struggling to click a photo. And out of nowhere, two young men came, both of them were looking 6 ft. I asked them to click a photo of me. They clicked but the photos weren't good. They asked me to click their photo. After seeing the photo, they instantly asked me, “where are you from?” “I'm from UP but I live in Mumbai to do my Bachelors” “Oh, What are you studying?” “Chemical Engineering” “Good good” On our way to new point, we decided to walk together. On the way, they asked my college, they said “bohot badhiya!” I asked them what do they do, and one of them works in Mumbai Airport in custom department. Yeah, I got friends that can be beneficial to me in the future. We talked about hell lot of things, they were from Haryana, one working in Goa and other one in Mumbai. They were in Matheran for 2 day trip. And Alexandra was their first point. A conversation between them, “Mera toh advanced qualify bhi nahi hua tha” “Thik hai na life me phir bhi acha kar rahe hai” And the dog started following us too… (Dog’s photos are very good honestly) We went to 2–3 beautiful points.. attaching images here… I can't recall the name… I can't recall name here too… Now, I got a good photo of mine… Which is my profile pic too.. We had lemon tea at this point, it was good like best thing I consumed there. And obviously, it was free for me🙂… Then arrived the 2nd most entertaining and scary part. We 3 homo sapiens & 1 dog were walking in a jungle type area. Suddenly voices of langoor start coming from everywhere! Dog was walking around 20M ahead. I was walking in the middle. Suddenly a langoor attacked dog.. This is the place where langoors live. It didn't take us long to realise that langoor has problem with dog not us. Dog was barking heavily and so langoors. We went lil back and dog come with us. Suddenly, all 4–5 langoor went somewhere and we crossed the way. (Blue hill is OTH and the way in red is my way to hostel or heaven, like I planned to rappel through it.) Then, I arrived at my favourite place. The place where we are going to be separated. One Tree Hill… My photo at OTH… I said goodbye to them, we shared number so that we can share images later. I don't know if they were lying but according to their conversations that I work only 3 hrs. in my job and I work only 1 hr. I think they were telling truth plus I asked them how to smuggle gold, and he gave practical advice to me, like how things work that they see your travel history on which they decided how much they can allow and obviously you can bribe. Anyways, let's not talk much about that here. “Neeche pohochke phone karna” their last words. (S4) It was around 5:20 PM as I saw them the last time. I was alone on a slippery rainfall way, I have to step on atleast 500 times on wet rocks. One wrong move and game over and I will be in news headlines. Honestly, I was scared to start this. Although initially the rocks were dry and looking good. I started and then there was no way back. I went some 20 M and I was stuck on a rock. I was not able to finalize my way, like how to go ahead cuz the path was difficult, it wasn't a path to be honest… I was wondering whether to go back or whatever. I washed my feet and decided what to do. Like the way was very steep and rocks would definitely k**l me. Except my phone, I put everything in my bag, including my debit cards, PAN cards, College ID Card, my wallet with some cash. And I threw my bag and it went some 10–20M before stopped by a rock. I can't narrate my journey. My legs were shivering. I was walking from 4:30 AM before the sunrise, it was sunrise time, my legs were already tired, they started hurting and now, I had to do this, rocks were hurting bottom of my feet. Inshort, meri ga**d fatt rahi thi. Honestly, I can't narrate this journey. (I can't believe that I trekked this when rocks were slippery) I'm biggest believer of everything happens for a reason, and as my life is progressing, I'm believing on it even more. Last week on Versova Beach, I fell on the ground after stepping on algae. Now, on my way, there was a lot of algae and since i know what it can do… if I didn't fell on Versova, I would've stepped on some algae here… I am glad that I fell on Versova Beach. Better than falling here… Not all bad events are bad. Thank You Versova. Otherwise… Some images is all I'd like to add… One more fool coming with me? No. He is local resident, he lives in the nearby village and trek this way everyday cuz he works as plumber at Matheran. There was one more guy who works as electrician there. Anyways, I was shirtless for some time since no one was there, the two guys were walking 50M ahead. Whenever they get much ahead, i used to ask them to wait for me. Imagine saying something bad or anything you want standing on a plateau… I said many things which I can't write here… Anyways, adding some more images… these are after my Rocky path ends.. Beautiful, right? The two guys who helped me! On the way, I gave my bag to one of them, and since he was used to the path, he was walking far ahead of me and his other friend who was behind me to look after me. I got guide for tree. At this point, I was using my blue shirt for wiping sweat. I sweat a lot, like a lot. For some 100M, I was shirtless but a jeans on bottom. It was fun honestly. I took a mini bath in a small waterfall. After reaching the bottom, the first i did was checking my bag and they stole nothing. I reached a village and my phone got dead. Like it had 5% battery only. S4 ends here. S5 some other day. I didn't narrated that well but hope you got basic idea. The day was 100X better than other days of my life. This is the story of my 20th birthday. The moment I'm writing this, my legs, hips, knees, shins are hurting like I can't walk properly🙂… (My white tee when I reached hostel room) ~ More to come That's it. ~ Trying to live a life worth remembering

Question: Have you been scammed? What happened and what did you lose?
Answer: Just try to read this till the end, you’ll definitely learn very good lessons. Ok, this is around a 7–8 Yr. old story if i recall correctly, I was in class 6th or 7th that time. I was 11–12 years old at that time, my brother was 3 Yr. older than me… so, he was 14–15. Our family conditions weren’t financially that good, so we used to regularly look for opportunities to make some extra income. It was one day that we received some message on our phone about a job offer, offering some 1.5k-2k a day for some work related to MS office, It was work from home, they had some office in delhi. It sounds lucrative and we weren’t that educated those times, we told this to our mother. She agreed to call them and let us disscuss more about it. On the call, a lady picked up, she said “tumhe delhi me hamare office aana hoga, Rs. 2000 joining ke liye dene honge and laptop ki zarurat hogi kaam karne ke liye”. The offer sounds good, and it attracted us, obviously there weren't that much information regarding scams those days like it is today. We fell into it. My father income was very less to buy even an entry level laptop. So, My mother decided to sell some of her wedding jewellery to arrange the money, so that we both can study and also do the work. We got the laptop, my brother and mother travelled to Delhi, and got everything done. They gave us some work to do with MS office, which I can't recall right now, but we weren't able to do that. When we called that number back to ask for some help, they didn't picked out call. They just scammed us with Rs. 2K. But now, we purchased the laptop which wasn't that useful for us, 7–8 yrs. ago, saari padhai copy books pe hoti thi na. Now guess what? Due to this scam, we got the laptop due to which (writing in order)… i) My mother's sister was doing her BioTech BSC but she didn't have money to get a laptop, my mom give that laptop to her so that she can complete her studies. She later returned it after doing her education, and then, ii) My brother cleared NEET, and got into medical college. He also did a lot of his studies with it. iii) then me, I cracked JEE Advanced using only that laptop (and 220 per month Vi recharge)😃 and got into IIT Bombay. Now, lesson? Jo hota hai ache ke liye hota hai. We can only see 400–700 nm of light, but God sees and makes your life according to entire spectrum. Just smile everytime, be humble and face every situation. Thank You. I don't know if people will read this or not, but I'm happy to share this with ya all. Image used is of my newer laptop, which I got in college (gift from a relative). I didn't have photo of my old laptop😅 Vansh Yadav, bye.

Question: What is unique about you?
Answer: Ok. This is going to be personal… I Hate Metro Cities I've been living in Mumbai for the past two years, and I've experienced almost everything the city has to offer. One thing I've realized is that I can't live in a place like this. The hustle and bustle make me uncomfortable, and I feel suffocated by the tall buildings. I don't enjoy walking through big malls or other large structures. Living in a metro city just isn't for me. I Don't Buy Expensive Electronics I don't like spending much on electronics. I know that expensive gadgets offer a smoother and safer experience, but I prefer to keep myself away from most electronic devices. The only electronic device I really like is my earphone. Maybe I'll consider a camera in the future if I stop using my smartphone. I'm seriously thinking of buying JioPhone and using it as my primary device. Let's see.. Once, it was a dream for me to have my own phone and laptop, and now that I have them all, I just hate this fake virtual world… I Like Travelling A Lot I like traveling and can do so without losing even 1 Calori of energy and I invest the money in travelling that I save from other expenses. I try to use those savings to enhance my travel experience. However, I travel less due to hectic college and a toxic home environment. Let's see when I can travel as per my convenience… I Hate Living In Apartments I don't like concrete structures; I prefer cities that are closer to nature. Honestly, I feel suffocated living in big concrete buildings. I would love to have a house in a small city with an open area to play badminton or cricket with my family, rather than owning a 2 BHK in some metro. I Wear Only 1 Color 95% of my wardrobe is blue. Question: What caused the Football War?
Answer: Football War, this is one of the most fascinating events from history. Let's understand everything behind it. In the hot summer of 1969, there was a lot of tension between two countries in Central America, El Salvador and Honduras. They had many problems like land issues and poor people moving from one country to the other. But things got really bad because of some football matches. (Img src : Google) Skip the context if you aren't interested much in history and politics between 2 random countries. [Context : The countries didn't have good relations with each other. El Salvador was 5X smaller than Honduras in size but it has more population. So, many people from El Salvador migrated to Honduras to do farming in the land of Honduras. In 1963, the man named Oswaldo Lopez Arellano (lets call him OLA in short lol) become the leader of country Honduras. He gave tax relaxations to American companies in return of winning the elections. Due to it, their economy started collapsing and he blamed Salvadorians for it. Hondurans started throwing them back to El Salvador and American companies took over the farm land. Salvadorians protested but it doesn't work.] Continuation… The football matches were part of the World Cup qualifiers. Football was a big deal for both countries. It was not just a game; it was something that made people very proud. It was a series of 3 matches. The first match was in Honduras, before the match, Hondurans disturbed Salvadorian players in their hotel which caused them sleep deficiency causing Honduras won. But after the match, there was a lot of fighting and trouble in the streets. The second match was in El Salvador. This time, El Salvador treated Honduran Players the same way and El Salvador won. The crowd was very happy, but there was also a lot of anger. The streets were full of people fighting. Both countries were very angry with each other. There was one more match to decide who would go to the World Cup. This match was in Mexico City, on neutral ground. El Salvador won again, but the anger between the two countries only grew stronger. (Graphic src : Google) A few days later, on July 14, 1969, El Salvador attacked Honduras. This started a war that lasted for about four days. There was a lot of fighting, and many people died or lost their homes. The war was called the "Football War" because the football matches were the final spark that started it. The "Football War" showed how small issues can become very big problems when there are already many tensions. Football was just the spark, but the real problems were much deeper. In the end, the war was a sad reminder of how conflicts can quickly get out of hand. This event gradually lead to a civil war in El Salvador. My take : When sports take over the mind of people (just like happening with cricket in India), It always impacted people negatively. Indians bully Pakistan players when they won and vice versa which is not a very good practice.
